贝拉很开心。他让她度过了快乐的一天。

妻子提醒他：他还没有完成答应帮忙买的东西。她告诉他，要么买完东西回家，要么就别回家！她也提醒他，她爱他。
然后，她挂断了电话。
It is Sports Day. Josh and William arrive ready for a big challenge.
Dinner is ready. Josh is happy, warm, and proud of William.
He wakes in a silent room, tied to a chair beneath a single lamp.
Two strangers sit across from him. Neither one says a word.
At last, one of them leans forward and asks a question.
He looks down at the rope and waits for the right moment.
In one sudden move, he frees himself and turns the room upside down.
The danger is over. Only the sound of his breathing remains.
He stands alone beneath the light and surveys the room.
He searches for anything that might explain why he was brought here.
There is no time to waste. He checks the last clue and makes a decision.
Without looking back, he walks into the dark corridor.
Detective Mason has been divorced for three months. His apartment is a mess, but his case files are perfectly organised.
His ex-wife calls. He lets the phone ring, already thinking about work.
Mason puts on his coat. He is married to the job now.
One coffee later, he is ready to leave the apartment.
He opens the door and steps into the quiet hallway.
An older woman is struggling with a heavy basket at the stairs.
Mason starts down the stairs, then stops. Some things are more important than the next case.
He carries her basket downstairs. For a moment, helping someone is enough.
